title: Why You Can't Ignore Movement in Your Peripheral Vision
hook: Movement in your peripheral vision is impossible to ignore.

narration.text: Your eyes automatically track moving objects, even when you are not paying attention.
Try to ignore something moving at the edge of your vision right now.
This happens because your brain prioritises potential threats or opportunities.
An ancient reflex redirects your gaze towards any movement, a survival mechanism.
It is a deep-seated instinct, even stronger than your conscious will.
This means your attention is constantly being pulled by the world around you.
Try it right now and tell me if it worked on you in the comments, like this if it surprised you, and subscribe to understand your own mind.

description: Ever wondered why you just cannot ignore movement at the edge of your vision? It is a powerful instinct rooted in ancient survival mechanisms, redirecting your attention automatically. This short explains the fascinating reason behind your brain's involuntary response to movement.
topic: Why your eyes automatically track movement, even if you are not paying attention. Try to ignore a moving object in your peripheral vision.
